artworks.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun
artworks.description: Poussin's Metropolitan landscape — blind Orion carried toward the healing sunrise, the hunter's myth as cosmic weather.

artworks.title: Diana next to the Corpse of Orion
artworks.description: Seiter's Diana beside Orion's corpse — the goddess and the giant she loved and killed, before the stars took him up.

artworks.title: Diana and Orion
artworks.description: Tischbein circle — Diana and Orion as courtly myth, the hunter still alive in the goddess's company.

artworks.title: Orion (libretto frontispiece)
artworks.description: Engraved frontispiece for Lacoste's opera Orion: the hunter and Diana framed for the stage — the myth as Parisian libretto ornament.

popCulture.title: Orion (constellation)
popCulture.description: The hunter's belt still marches across winter skies — Orion's saga written in the most recognisable constellation in either hemisphere.
